title: ELMES: An Automated Framework for Evaluating Large Language Models in Educational Scenarios
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focused on evaluating the pedagogical capabilities of LLMs in four educational scenarios: Knowledge Point Explanation, Guided Problem-Solving Teaching, Interdisciplinary Lesson Plan Generation, and Contextualized Question Generation.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on evaluating the pedagogical capabilities of large language models in educational contexts.
